title: AWS PrivateLink
explanation: AWS PrivateLink provides private connectivity between VPCs, supported AWS services, and your on-premises networks without exposing traffic to the public internet. It creates an elastic network interface in your subnet.
analogy: PrivateLink is like a private delivery tunnel between buildings — packages (data) travel directly without ever going through the public street.
keyPoints: Traffic stays on the AWS network — never traverses the public internet
Uses interface VPC endpoints (ENIs in your subnet)
Supports access to AWS services and third-party SaaS via AWS Marketplace
No need for IGW, NAT, VPN, or Direct Connect for the connected service

examKeywords.definition: A technology providing private connectivity between VPCs and services using interface endpoints (ENIs), keeping traffic off the public internet.

commonMistakes: Confusing PrivateLink (interface endpoints) with Gateway endpoints (S3/DynamoDB only)
Not understanding that PrivateLink endpoints are AZ-scoped
